desc: This Checkbox was posted by fajar_5006. Tagged with: checkbox, minimalist, interface, checkbox, toggle, dot, grid, design.
html:
<label class="cursor-pointer group" title="Hamburger Menu">
  <input type="checkbox" class="hidden" />
  <svg
    stroke-width="3"
    class="block w-8 h-8 fill-none stroke-slate-800 overflow-hidden"
    xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
  >
    <g
      class="origin-center group-has-[:checked]:rotate-45 transition-transform uration-300 ease-out"
    >
      <circle
        cx="4"
        cy="4"
        r="2"
        class="group-hover:translate-x-3 transition-transform group-has-[:checked]:hidden"
      ></circle>
      <circle cx="16" cy="4" r="2"></circle>
      <circle
        cx="28"
        cy="4"
        r="2"
        class="group-hover:translate-y-3 transition-transform group-has-[:checked]:hidden"
      ></circle>

      <circle cx="4" cy="16" r="2"></circle>
      <circle cx="16" cy="16" r="2"></circle>
      <circle cx="28" cy="16" r="2"></circle>

      <circle
        cx="4"
        cy="28"
        r="2"
        class="group-hover:-translate-y-3 transition-transform group-has-[:checked]:hidden"
      ></circle>
      <circle cx="16" cy="28" r="2"></circle>
      <circle
        cx="28"
        cy="28"
        r="2"
        class="group-hover:-translate-x-3 transition-transform group-has-[:checked]:hidden"
      ></circle>
    </g>
  </svg>
</label>
